features: The blog publishes a feed at /rss.xml, so you can follow it in a reader.
A long-form post covers what happens between two calendars, and where syncing usually goes wrong.
A roundup of nine calendar sync tools compares price, speed and detail, with a link for every figure.
Two guides walk through connecting iCloud with Outlook, and Google Calendar with iCloud.
improvements: Public pages are cached now, so they arrive noticeably quicker.
fixes: Multi-line code blocks render as blocks instead of picking up inline styling.
A mistyped post address shows the normal not-found page instead of a blank one.
Upgrading a self-hosted install running roughly v2.10.2 through v2.12.2 works again, and finishes far faster.
Faint dates and read-only fields are easier to read, and now meet WCAG AA.
One oversized repeating event no longer stops the rest of its calendar syncing.
